test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some hats are mats.

No mat is a bat.

**Conclusion:**

(I) : Some hats are bats.

(II) : Some mats are hats.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fedd34aca8c250db894f917efa566f101033d133e0650092ff78e9e33072191d.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) : Some hats are bats → Does not follow (As some hats are mats and no mat is a bat. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) : Some mats are hats → Follow (As some hats are mats. As some part of hats is common with mats, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
